question.text: A thin spherical insulating shell of radius <math><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi></math> carries a uniformly distributed charge such that the potential at its surface is <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow></msub></math> . A hole with a small area <math><mi mathvariant="normal">α</mi><mn>4</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">π</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">α</mi><mo>≪</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> is made on the shell without affecting the rest of the shell. Which one of the following statements is correct?

options.text: The magnitude of electric field at the center of the shell is reduced by  <math><mfrac><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">α</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow></msub></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi></mrow></mfrac></math>
The potential at the center of the shell is reduced by  <math><mn>2</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">α</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow></msub></math>

The ratio of the potential at the center of the shell to that of the point at  <math><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi></math>  from center towards the hole will be  <math><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">α</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">α</mi></mrow></mfrac></math>

The magnitude of electric field at a point, located on a line passing through the hole and shell's center on a distance  <math><mn>2</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi></math>  from the center of the spherical shell will be reduced by  <math><mfrac><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">α</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow></msub></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi></mrow></mfrac></math>

solution.text:
Let ‘A’ be the point at a distance 2R from center and ‘B’ be the point at a distance of R2 from center.
Now, let total charge on spherical shell distributed uniformly =Q
⇒ Charge per unit area=Q4πr2
Charge on elemental area ‘dA’ .
Given potential at surface =V0
⇒V0=KQR
Now, potential at center of the shell =VC
VC=KQR-K(dQ)R=KQR-K(αQ)R=KQR(1-α)
⇒VC=V01-α⇒Reduced by αV0
Now potential =VB
⇒VB=KQR-KaQR/2=V01-2a⇒Reduced by 2αV0
∴VCVB=1-a1-2a
Now, electric field at A=EA
Then, EA=KQ2R2-KaQR2=KQ4R2-aV0R
So reduced by aV0R
Electric field at center ‘C’ due to small change ‘dQ’
EC=KdqR2=KαQR2=αV0R
So increased by aV0R
